300 STUDENT APARTMENTS PROPOSED

A new state filing outlines a 30-story student housing project at 2307 Rio Grande Street in West Campus.

Registered October 23 with the Texas Department of Licensing and Regulation, the project lists 300 apartments and approximately 466,000 square feet. The reported construction cost estimate is $97.3 million.

The filing describes study spaces, a fitness area, a pool deck and five levels of parking—three below ground and two above.

Its submitted schedule targets a February 2027 start and July 2028 completion. Those are estimates supplied in the filing, not confirmed construction milestones.

Why it matters: This is a substantial potential addition to student housing near UT, worth tracking as West Campus continues to develop. The filing does not establish future rents, affordability restrictions or an effect on surrounding rental prices.

TDLR currently lists the project as registered. An accessibility registration does not establish that all City permits have been issued or that construction has begun.

Source: TDLR, project TABS2027004314, registered October 23, 2026.
